objective: Preallocate column-scan aggregate index-probe data keys from table and row-id lengths.

tasks.title: Preallocate column-scan index-probe data keys
tasks.result: Column-scan aggregate index-probe row fetches now use an explicit-capacity helper instead of format! for data keys.

notes: Cargo verification used an E: workspace temp directory and CARGO_PROFILE_TEST_DEBUG=0 to avoid recurring MSVC PDB pressure.
The helper reserves capacity for data:<table>:<row_id> before pushing known components.
The optimization replaces format! in primary-key and indexed-column aggregate index-probe row fetches.
Generated key bytes, transaction get lookups, aggregate state updates, predicate filtering, and SQL results are unchanged.
